label: Load open identifier/certification data
details: Use NVD CPE, ENERGY STAR Computers, EPEAT, FCC and ISED REL as open/reference layers before live pricing.

label: Add communications/RF compliance evidence
details: Use FCC Equipment Authorization and ISED REL for wireless transmitters, cell phones, radios, CB/FRS/GMRS, microwave and Wi-Fi equipment.

label: Add manufacturer/distributor feeds
details: Use Lenovo PSREF, Dell datasheets/Premier, Ingram Micro flat files/API and TD SYNNEX APIs where access is available.

label: Add radio/frequency context
details: Use RadioReference for scanner/radio frequency context where terms allow; do not confuse frequency data with product-offer rows.

label: Normalize to IT/communications offers
details: Map SKU, MPN, price, stock, specs, certifications, lifecycle, FCC/ISED IDs, CPE and CVU score into ComputerITCommunicationsComparableOffer.
